THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Butter Caramel Popcorn Creami

Movie-theater popcorn in the Ninja Creami (8.8/10): a butter-popcorn-seasoned and caramel-emulsion protein base spun and loaded with LesserEvil Himalayan Gold popcorn and sugar-free salted caramel inside and on top. About 270 calories and 35g protein for the whole finished pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME24 hr freeze + 5 min rest + spin
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~270 cal | ~35g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Process on Regular Ice Cream (not Lite), and run Respin without adding extra liquid.

Ingredients

BASE

  • 1 cup (240ml) Nurri plain 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1/2 labelled serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (60 cal / 14g protein)
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum, leveled
  • Pinch of salt (usual base)
  • 1 tsp Kernel Season’s Butter Popcorn Seasoning
  • 1/2 tsp LorAnn Caramel Bakery Emulsion

MIX-IN

  • 5g LesserEvil Himalayan Gold butter-flavor popcorn
  • 1/2 tbsp Jordan’s Skinny Mixes Sugar Free Salted Caramel Sauce

TOPPING

  • 5g LesserEvil Himalayan Gold butter-flavor popcorn
  • 1/2 tbsp Jordan’s Skinny Mixes Sugar Free Salted Caramel Sauce (10g popcorn and 1 tbsp caramel total)

Allergens: dairy.

You want a salty-sweet movie-theater butter caramel popcorn ice cream pint for ~270 calories and 35g protein across the entire finished pint.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND & FREEZE BASE. Blend 1 cup Nurri plain 2% milk, 1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate, 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener, 1/8 tsp leveled guar gum, a pinch of salt, 1 tsp Kernel Season’s Butter Popcorn Seasoning, and 1/2 tsp LorAnn Caramel Bakery Emulsion until smooth. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.
  2. 2.REST & FIRST SPIN. Rest the pint on the counter for 5 minutes, then process on Regular Ice Cream (not Lite).
  3. 3.ADD MIX-INS & RESPIN. Add 5g LesserEvil Himalayan Gold popcorn and 1/2 tbsp Jordan’s Skinny Mixes sugar-free salted caramel sauce to the center well. Run Respin without adding liquid.
  4. 4.TOP & SERVE. Finish the pint with the remaining 5g popcorn and 1/2 tbsp sugar-free salted caramel sauce (10g popcorn and 1 tbsp caramel total across mix-in and topping).

Keys to success

  • Total additions across mix-in and topping are 10g LesserEvil Himalayan Gold popcorn and 1 tbsp Jordan’s Skinny Mixes sugar-free salted caramel sauce.
  • The salted popcorn seasoning, salted popcorn, usual pinch of salt, and salted caramel all contribute to a lingering movie-theater salty finish; reducing the seasoning or omitting the extra pinch of salt is an optional future adjustment (not tested here).

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the blended base upright and level for up to 1 week. Add the popcorn and caramel sauce when spinning to serve.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint.

Lasts: Unspun frozen pint keeps 1 week; enjoy immediately after Respin and topping.

Estimated nutrition

~270 cal | ~35g protein per 1 whole finished Creami pint (with 10g popcorn + 1 tbsp caramel sauce).

Calculated whole-pint estimate is ~271.8 calories and 34.7g protein, rounded to ≈270 calories and 35g protein for the entire finished pint including all mix-ins and toppings. Breakdown: 1 cup Nurri plain 2% milk (150 cal, 20g protein) + 1/2 serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (60 cal, 14g protein) + 1 tsp Kernel Season’s Butter Popcorn Seasoning (8 cal, 0g protein; manufacturer basis 2 cal per 1/4 tsp) + 1/2 tsp LorAnn Caramel Bakery Emulsion (~6.4 cal allowance for ~3g / 2.5ml at 212 kcal/100g) + 10g total LesserEvil Himalayan Gold popcorn (~46.4 cal, 0.7g protein from 130 cal / 2g protein per 28g label) + 1 tbsp total Jordan’s Skinny Mixes sugar-free salted caramel sauce (0 cal label) + sweetener/guar/salt (1 cal).
